snippet.title: I See Red - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
I See Red is a roguelite twin-stick shooter in which Humans, Robots and Aliens will stand in your way as you rage through different spaceships to find your revenge. Experiment with a multitude of tactics and fighting styles thanks to the many available weapons, varied level design, destructible environment, various skill combinations, grappling hook, and more!

NOW AVAILABLE FOR PC!

Buy on Steam: https://bit.ly/ISR-Steam
Buy on Epic Games: https://bit.ly/ISR-Epic
